title: Settings
themeHint: System follows your operating system's appearance.
autoRefreshHint: How often to poll the repository. File changes are picked up instantly regardless.
profilesHint: Choose which name, email and SSH key a repository commits with. Applied to the open repository only — your global git config is left alone.
profileSshKeyHint: Optional. Sets core.sshCommand so fetch, pull and push use this key.
signCommitsHint: Sets gpg.format=ssh and commit.gpgsign so commits show as verified.
signCommitsNeedsKey: Add an SSH key first to enable commit signing.
cleared: Repository is back on your global git config
deleteProfileMessage: "{{label}}" will be removed from the app. Repositories already configured with it keep their git config.
noLocalIdentity: This repository has no local identity — it uses your global git config.
